name: home-network-monitor
description: Self-hosted dashboard that discovers and monitors every device on a local network

scripts.db:seed:e2e: cross-env DB_FILE=./data/e2e.db ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.node.json scripts/e2e-seed.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run type-check && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
scripts.perf:dataset: cross-env DB_FILE=./data/perf.db ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.node.json scripts/perfDataset.ts
scripts.perf: cross-env DB_FILE=./data/perf.db ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.node.json scripts/perf.ts
scripts.soak: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc DB_FILE=./data/soak.db ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.node.json scripts/soak.ts
scripts.perf:fcp: cross-env DB_FILE=./data/fcp.db ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.node.json scripts/fcp.ts

//overrides: Next 15.5.26 pins postcss 8.4.31, which lands a nested copy that npm audit
flags as high severity (XSS via unescaped </style> in stringify output, plus
an arbitrary-file-read issue). The root already resolves 8.5.28, so the
nested copy is pure duplication. Overriding it clears both advisories
without waiting for a Next major, and the build plus the full suite are
verified against the result.
postcss's own source-map-js resolves to 1.2.1, which npm audit flags as high
severity (event-loop DoS via indexed source-map section offsets); 1.2.2 is
the patch and postcss's range already permits it, so the pin only forces the
re-resolve.
solid-js arrives under @tanstack/react-query-devtools (the Devtools UI is
built with Solid). solid-js 1.9.15 pins seroval ~1.5.4, and every seroval
<=1.6.2 carries two critical advisories, so no seroval within that range can
be patched. solid-js 1.9.17 moves to seroval ~1.6.8; overriding solid-js is
what actually clears them. Kept as an override rather than a direct
dependency because nothing here imports solid-js by name.
handlebars is pulled in transitively by ts-jest 29.x (its template helpers).
4.7.9 carries three critical/high advisories (CVE-2026-106444/45/46);
4.7.10 is the first patched release and is a patch-level bump, so overriding
is safe. Nothing in this repo renders untrusted Handlebars templates.
postcss-selector-parser 6.1.4 (under tailwindcss 3.4) is O(n^2) on flat
selectors (CVE-2026-104844). 7.1.6 is the patch; tailwindcss's range does
not reach it, so the override forces the re-resolve. Build-time CSS only,
no untrusted selector input.
js-yaml 3.15.2 (under @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config, used only by jest
coverage) depends on argparse 1.0.10, which depends on sprintf-js 1.0.3 with
no patched release (CVE-2026-97058). js-yaml 4.x dropped the argparse
dependency entirely; its single caller here uses js-yaml.load() only, which
4.x still provides (safe by default). Overriding clears the last open alert.
